evals.prompt: Create a project plan from `docs/prd.md`. The PRD describes a customer-facing saved-search feature with user stories for creating saved searches, receiving email alerts, editing alert frequency, and deleting saved searches. Produce the default single plan artifact and prepare it for a later `plan-to-beads-unified` pass.
evals.expected_output: A single `docs/project-plan.md` artifact with outcome-oriented epics, vertical-slice tasks, task IDs, dependencies, acceptance criteria, PRD traceability, Agent Handoff Packets, parallel-safety metadata, and explicit handoff notes for `plan-to-beads-unified`.
expectations: The output is a single project-plan artifact rather than local issue files.
The plan groups work into epics with stable IDs such as E01 and E02.
Tasks use stable IDs such as T001 and are shaped as vertical slices with observable acceptance criteria.
Execution-ready tasks include Agent Handoff Packets with context to read, expected public interface, constraints, verification command, and closeout criteria.
Tasks include Parallel-safe, Collision domain, Can run with, and Must not run with fields.
The plan includes a handoff section instructing `plan-to-beads-unified` to convert only execution-ready tasks and preserve Agent Handoff Packets.

evals.prompt: Read `docs/prd.md` and create a project plan. The PRD includes unclear requirements around admin approval, audit logging, and retention policy. Mark anything that needs a human decision before implementation, but still sequence the AFK tasks that can start immediately.
evals.expected_output: A single project plan that marks ambiguous or decision-dependent work as HITL or not execution-ready, while preserving a useful sequence of AFK vertical-slice tasks with Agent Handoff Packets and conservative parallel-safety metadata.
expectations: The plan explicitly separates AFK tasks from HITL tasks.
Ambiguous admin approval, audit logging, or retention policy work is marked as HITL or Execution-ready: No.
AFK tasks are still sequenced so implementation can begin without blocked decision work.
Execution-ready AFK tasks include complete Agent Handoff Packets.
Collision domains are called out for tasks that should not run in parallel.
Risks and open questions are tied to affected epics or tasks.

evals.prompt: I have a PRD at `docs/billing-prd.md`. Build the upstream project plan only; do not create Beads items yet. I want to review epics and tasks first, then use the plan-to-beads-unified workflow after approval.
evals.expected_output: A single `docs/project-plan.md` written as `status: draft` for review and set to `status: approved` only after the user approves, preserving task IDs, dependencies, execution-readiness, PRD traceability, Agent Handoff Packets, and parallel-safety metadata for downstream Beads generation.
expectations: The workflow asks for user approval before writing or finalizing the plan.
The skill does not create local issue files or Beads items.
The plan references `docs/billing-prd.md` as the parent PRD.
The handoff notes explain that `plan-to-beads-unified` should run after approval using the plan and parent PRD.
The handoff notes require `plan-to-beads-unified` to preserve Agent Handoff Packets and parallel-safety metadata.
